_comment: Driver web build size budget (START-HERE step 50 / plan U4, owner Q51 2026-11-09). Per variant: budget = main.dart.js measured on 2026-11-10 + 2 %, rounded up to the next KiB. Until warn_until a breach of the budget is a GitHub warning (exit 0); from that date on it fails the job (exit 1). hard_* is the older CI limit (Phase 7 baseline + ~10 %), which fails at once, warn window or not; the demo budget is capped at it so nothing is loosened. Raise a budget on purpose, in the change that needs the bytes, and write the new measurement here.

demo.description: flutter build web --release (verify job; the GitHub Pages demo)

live.description: flutter build web --release --wasm --dart-define=MOVERA_AUTH_REQUIRED=true ... (live-web job and the deploy workflow). About 94 KB raw / 25 KB gzip bigger than the demo: the define keeps the live-only code (session gate, live home, live accept-ride, live services in main.dart) that dart2js tree-shakes out of the demo; --wasm and the other defines do not change main.dart.js.
